import mir_eval

adj_ref_intervals, adj_ref_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
    ref_intervals, ref_labels, t_min=0.0
)
adj_est_intervals, adj_est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
    est_intervals, est_labels, t_min=0.0, t_max=adj_ref_intervals.max()
)

S_over, S_under, S_F = mir_eval.segment.nce(
    adj_ref_intervals, 
    adj_ref_labels, 
    adj_est_intervals, 
    adj_est_labels,
    marginal=True
)

expected_f = 2 * S_over * S_under / (S_over + S_under) if (S_over + S_under) > 0 else 0.0
assert abs(S_F - expected_f) < 1e-7, f"F-measure mismatch: {S_F} vs {expected_f}"
assert 0.0 <= S_over <= 1.0 and 0.0 <= S_under <= 1.0, "Scores must be bounded between 0 and 1"

print(f"__CHECK__ nce {S_over:.4f}, {S_under:.4f}, {S_F:.4f}")
